turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: I have a pain here, in my stomach. Since yesterday.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: ठीक छ, भन्नुभएकोमा धन्यवाद। दुखाइ घोचेजस्तो छ, कि dull ache जस्तो?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Is it serious? What should I do?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: सायद त्यति गम्भीर होइन, तर म एकपटक जाँच गर्न चाहन्छु। पानी पिउनुहोस्, आराम गर्नुहोस्, and come back if the pain gets worse or you get a fever.
